title: v2.1.116 Remaining Features: Resume Speed, Thinking Spinner, Config Search, Sandbox Safety
description: v2.1.116 additional features not yet filed: (1) /resume 67% faster on sessions 40MB+ — handles dead-fork entries more efficiently; high relevance for long heartbeat sessions. (2) Thinking spinner shows inline progress ('still thinking', 'thinking more', 'almost done thinking') — better UX signal during long operations. (3) /config search now matches option values (e.g. searching 'vim' finds Editor mode setting). (4) /reload-plugins and background plugin auto-update now auto-install missing plugin dependencies — reduces friction. (5) Sandbox auto-allow no longer bypasses dangerous-path safety check for rm/rmdir — security hardening.
